name: ioe-2084-planner
description: Adaptive IOE (B.E./B.Arch.) entrance study planner — zero runtime dependencies, runs offline in the browser.

scripts.validate: node tests/engine.test.js && node -e "import('./src/core/store.js').then(async (s)=>{const st=s.defaultState();const {buildIndex}=await import('./src/core/model.js');const {allSubjectGroups,SYLLABUS_META}=await import('./data/syllabus.js');const {runValidation}=await import('./src/core/validate.js');const r=runValidation(st,{index:buildIndex(allSubjectGroups(false))});console.log(JSON.stringify({syllabus:SYLLABUS_META.version,errors:r.errors.length,warnings:r.warnings.length,ok:r.ok},null,2));if(!r.ok)process.exit(1);})"
